spec.notes: Every product card has its own Add to cart button; use the one in the Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt card. The cart icon in the top-right corner opens the cart. Checkout asks for First Name, Last Name and Zip/Postal Code, then Continue, then Finish. This demo account is documented as broken: the finish button is expected not to work.

checks.cart_has_one_item: The cart icon in the header shows the badge 1
checks.on_checkout_form: The page heading says 'Checkout: Your Information' and shows First Name, Last Name and Zip/Postal Code fields
checks.overview_lists_tshirt: The page heading says 'Checkout: Overview' and the item list includes Sauce Labs Bolt T-Shirt
checks.field_error: A red error message says a field is required or has a problem

order_complete.when: The page heading says 'Checkout: Complete!' and the text 'Thank you for your order!' is shown

form_error.when: The checkout form shows a red error message such as 'Error: Last Name is required'
form_error.note: every field has a value in data; a required-field error after they were filled is the app's defect

app_error.when: An error page, a stack trace or 'something went wrong' text is shown
